newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel diffs near steady in thin activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel diffs near steady in thin activity.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel differentials showed little change Thursday in what traders characterized as thin trading.

On the NYMEX, the August heating oil contract, which reached expiration at the close, dropped 0.17 cent to settle at 55.61 cents a gallon, and the September contract firmed 0.07 cent to finish at 56.19 cents.

U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade barrels changed hands at 0.45 cent over the September futures, the high end of the recent trading range, while 55-grade low sulphur jet fuel traded at 0.70 and 0.75 cent over the futures.
New York Harbor 54-grade barrels for delivery near mid-August were seen done at 3.10 and 3.20 cents over the September futures.
